prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a professional model turnaround sheet for ONE ORIGINAL CUTE FARM SHEEP for a 2D adventure game. Art direction: the charming hand-inked barnyard comics of U.S. Acres / Orson's Farm: clear species-specific cartoon anatomy, simple expressive oval eyes, clean black linework, restrained flat cream and peach colors, no rendering or texture. This MUST be unmistakably a SHEEP: large round cloud of scalloped wool as the torso, small fleece cap, long HORIZONTAL sheep ears projecting sideways, a small elongated peach oval sheep face, tiny nostril marks and a simple Y-shaped sheep mouth, four short thin legs ending in small BLACK CLOVEN HOOVES, tiny wool tail. NO black round dog nose, NO floppy dog ears, NO white dog paws, NO protruding canine muzzle, NO tongue. Cute confident expression rather than a generic puppy smile. Low sturdy quadruped with torso much bigger than head. Five fully visible standing views in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW: right side, front-right diagonal, front, rear-right diagonal, back. FIXED ORTHOGRAPHIC CAMERA looking down at 30 degrees in every view: visible top of wool and muzzle, same height/volume/leg length in every view. Body turns around vertical axis only, never a flat side camera or elongated frontal body. Keep all four feet grounded, no walking yet. Same character, same drawing scale. Generous space around each complete silhouette. Transparent background, no scenery, no shadows, no labels.
role: species model study, not live game art
